gmail.client_required: Enter a Google Desktop OAuth client ID first.
gmail.authorize: Authorize Gmail in the browser on the service host, then return here.
gmail.different_account: Create a new connection for a different Gmail account.
gmail.failed: Gmail authorization failed. Check the OAuth configuration and retry.
gmail.source_description: Read-only Gmail messages and thread evidence.

client_id.label: Google Desktop OAuth client ID
client_id.description: Enable Gmail API in your Google Cloud project and create an OAuth client of type Desktop app.

client_secret.label: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: The client secret from the Desktop OAuth credentials, when required. Stored in the credential vault.

account_email.label: Connected account
account_email.description: Set by Gmail authorization. Create another connection to use another account.

allow_query.label: Allow on-demand mail checks
allow_query.description: Allow unified retrieval to check this mailbox when retained evidence is incomplete or current state is needed.

initial_sync_lookback_days.label: Initial sync days
initial_sync_lookback_days.description: Days to import at the start of this connection. On-demand queries can search older mail.

connect.label: Connect Gmail
connect.description: Use a Google Desktop OAuth client. Complete authorization in a browser on the Magi service host.

disconnect.label: Disconnect Gmail
disconnect.description: Remove the local authorization token and stop mailbox access. Retained memories remain governed separately.

activation.title: Connect Gmail
activation.description: Configure a Desktop OAuth client, authorize Gmail, then enable sync. Mail bodies are stored locally as external evidence.

mail.description: Read-only Gmail messages and thread evidence.
